super6.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
super6.comment: Foaled February 20. 150,000 gns yearling, €330,000 2-y-o, Lope De Vega colt. Brother to 2-y-o 7.4f winner Terre de Vega and 2-y-o 7f winner Tierra Del Toro, both useful. Dam, 1¼m winner, sister to dual Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe winner Treve. One to note on debut.

super6.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
super6.comment: Not beaten far on first start in bumpers but was well held in more testing conditions when last seen in January. Switches to hurdles but appeals as more of a chasing type.

super6.race: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
super6.comment: Sole success came at this course as a juvenile and has run some creditable races in defeat since. Goes back up in trip but may need a few of these to falter to gain a first handicap win.

super6.race: Jumps Looks Better On Racing TV Mares' Handicap Chase
super6.comment: Handicap hurdle winner at Doncaster in February but yet to convince over fences and she makes little appeal after 5 months off.

Youmzain gelding. Brother to fairly useful hurdler Big Chou, and half-brother to 2 winners, including bumper winner/fairly useful 17f hurdle winner Skerry Hill. Yard knows this family well and he's probably one for later on.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: 180,000 gns yearling who showed promise amidst greenness when third of 12 in novice at Newmarket (7f) on debut 23 days ago, the race run in a good time. Stamina on dam's side of pedigree and he's a major player up in trip.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun EBF Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: Foaled February 20. 150,000 gns yearling, €330,000 2-y-o, Lope De Vega colt. Brother to 2-y-o 7.4f winner Terre de Vega and 2-y-o 7f winner Tierra Del Toro, both useful. Dam, 1¼m winner, sister to dual Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe winner Treve. One to note on debut.

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Not beaten far on first start in bumpers but was well held in more testing conditions when last seen in January. Switches to hurdles but appeals as more of a chasing type.

finals.race: Sunday At The Races With Greendale EBF Junior 'National Hunt' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Doha Dream gelding. Half-brother to 4 winners, including French 19f chase winner Juste Milieu and fairly useful chaser Impatient (3m winner). Dam, placed on Flat in France, half-sister to fairly useful French hurdler (17f/2¼m winner) Sister Palma. Yard capable of readying a newcomer.

finals.race: Join Racing TV Now With A Free Trial Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: €70,000 3-y-o, Crystal Ocean gelding. Out of a sister to useful hurdler/fairly useful chaser (winner up to 3¼m) Cup Final and fairly useful hurdler/useful chaser (stayed 2½m) Asta La Pasta out of high-class 2¼m-3m hurdle winner Asian Maze.

finals.race: Midnite It's Actually Pretty Good Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Sole success came at this course as a juvenile and has run some creditable races in defeat since. Goes back up in trip but may need a few of these to falter to gain a first handicap win.

finals.race: Jumps Looks Better On Racing TV Mares' Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Handicap hurdle winner at Doncaster in February but yet to convince over fences and she makes little appeal after 5 months off.

Lightly-raced sort who made a perfect start over fences when winning a Fairyhouse maiden last season but hasn't kicked on in novices or handicaps since. Stable is in excellent form but this looks too competitive.

finals.race: Exminster Golf Club Supporting Elf Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Held his form well last season, scoring at Southwell in February and placed on both subsequent starts, though doubtful he was at his very best last time after a jumping lapse. Considered on reappearance with yard going great guns (has had breathing operation).

finals.race: Get A Free Trial At racingtv.com/freetrial Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Back to something like his best when a length second on return from a lengthy absence at Bangor (23f), took keen hold in front and only held late on. Good-value jockey able to claim this time and a similar performance should be enough to go one better (has form in higher grades).

finals.race: William Hill Challenge Series Irish EBF Beginners Chase
finals.comment: Made a positive start under Rules, winning maiden hurdle at Wexford (2½m) in October 2025 before a good second in novice at Fairyhouse. However, pulled up all 3 starts this year, including back from 4 months off at Galway festival. Off since ahead of this chase bow. Blinkers on.

finals.race: Midnite Ain't Your Grandad's Bookie Handicap
finals.comment: Thorough stayer who won over 2¼m at Pontefract 48 days ago before third of 12 in a handicap at Kempton over 2m 27 days ago on return to all-weather. Went in snatches last time and the return of cheekpieces could help so she's respected.

Youmzain gelding. Brother to fairly useful hurdler Big Chou, and half-brother to 2 winners, including bumper winner/fairly useful 17f hurdle winner Skerry Hill. Yard knows this family well and he's probably one for later on.

finals.race: William Hill Challenge Series Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Landed a gamble when beating 14 rivals by 6½ lengths over 2½m at Fairyhouse 19 days ago, and, while a 10 lb rise demands more, his pedigree suggests this longer trip can unlock further progress; shortlisted.
